windowTitle: Serial integration stage 1 - restore the CloudIdentity policy generator's reproducibility
scope: Read-only diagnosis plus a generator-source fix. The committed generated file is unchanged; only the generator that must reproduce it was corrected. No contract, schema, proto, generator output, provider or production change.
finding: The canonical authorization/status generator services/gateway-integration/identity/generate_policy.py did not reproduce its committed output. Section 11.1 requires reproducible generators. Running it dropped the two workspace-audience administrative-operation rows (listAdminOperations, reconcileOperation) and all five runtime_control rows (listRuntimeVersions, registerRuntimeVersion, setRuntimeVersionStatus, getBuildRuntimePolicy, setBuildRuntimePolicy), because 'bff' and 'runtime_control' were omitted from the owner set, so the committed file and the generator disagreed and a regeneration would have silently dropped seven real policy rows.
implemented: services/gateway-integration/identity/generate_policy.py: added 'runtime_control' (whose five operations the runtime_control special-case already overrides) and 'bff' (which supplies the two workspace-audience admin-operation reads) to the scanned owner set. The committed policy_generated.go is now reproduced byte-for-byte by the generator.

commands: cd services/gateway-integration/identity && python3 generate_policy.py ; diff -q policy_generated.go <git show HEAD:...>
verification.environment: python3 + the real 03_api_contract_complete.yaml; no external dependency
cases: The generator now emits exactly the 99-row, 8-owner table that TestGeneratedPolicyCoversAssignedOwners pins (runtime_control=5, workspace=18), reproduced byte-for-byte from the committed file.
The generated policy and BFF status tables are unchanged; only generate_policy.py changed.

notRun: No full docs/spec/target check suite rerun: no SOURCE_FILES input (03 yaml, schema.sql, db_inventory, internal.proto, publisher schema, semantics_cases, validate_cross_domain.py, 13, plan-change-policy) changed.
No Candidate build, deployment, provider or production action.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims a generator-source reproducibility fix with focused tests: the CloudIdentity policy generator now reproduces its committed output. It claims no contract/schema change, no runtime behavior change, no deployment.
